claims.claim: JEDEC's DDR6 preview sets a baseline transfer rate of 12.8 GT/s, more than double DDR5's baseline, and quadruples memory bandwidth per module.
claims.episode_span: JEDEC previews DDR6 at 12.8 GT/s, quadrupling DDR5 module bandwidth.
claims.source_title: DDR6 RAM shrinks by 44% while delivering 4X DDR5's baseline bandwidth
claims.supporting_quote: From a performance perspective, DDR6 will debut at 12.8 GT/s, more than double DDR5's baseline transfer rate, while also quadrupling the memory bandwidth per memory module thanks to a new design.

claims.claim: DDR6 baseline module bandwidth is 153.6 GB/s versus 38.4 GB/s for DDR5, on a 96-bit bus with four 24-bit sub-channels, and modules are 74 mm versus 133 mm.
claims.episode_span: Baseline bandwidth per module is 153.6 GB/s, against 38.4 GB/s for DDR5
claims.source_title: DDR6 RAM shrinks by 44% while delivering 4X DDR5's baseline bandwidth
claims.supporting_quote: Using the baseline for comparison, DDR6 offers up to 153.6 GB/s of total module bandwidth, compared to DDR5's 38.4 GB/s.

claims.claim: DDR6 peak JEDEC rates in the preview are 14,400 MT/s and 172.8 GB/s per module, bank count is 64, and 128 Gb dies are supported, with RDIMMs potentially scaling to 1 TB or more per slot.
claims.episode_span: Peak JEDEC rates in the preview table are 14,400 MT/s and 172.8 GB/s per module
claims.source_title: DDR6 RAM shrinks by 44% while delivering 4X DDR5's baseline bandwidth
claims.supporting_quote: DDR6 could raise module capacity to 128GB or 256GB and potentially scale RDIMMs to 1TB or more per slot.
